$description: Control Room design tokens — framework-agnostic (DTCG). Generated from tokens/tokens.json; do not edit by hand.

brd-hair.$description: hairline — dot/tag outlines, row separators, dense chrome (thinner than --brd)

shadow-off-sm.$description: small floating pieces — menus, chips, popovers

state-hover-mix.$description: amount of --ink mixed into a surface on hover (color-mix)

focus-offset.$description: keyboard focus-ring offset from the control edge

motion-intensity.$description: loudness dial (0..1) for non-essential animation; the `calm` ops profile sets 0

decoration-intensity.$description: loudness dial (0..1) for decorative texture layers; the `calm` ops profile tones it down

font-mono.$value: "CR Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

ease-snap.$description: hard, decisive — the house feel (no soft overshoot/bounce)

cr-accordion-border.$description: outer chassis edge of the accordion (against --board); NOT the between-item seam

cr-datagrid-border.$description: outer frame + head rule of the grid (chassis edge); NOT the row rule

cr-datagrid-seam.$description: internal row rule between body rows (against --cr-datagrid-bg)

on-sig.$description: text/icon placed on a signal fill

on-err.$description: text/icon on an error (--sig-err) fill; white in light, dark elsewhere

mass.$description: black as a large fill area (Law 1)

halftone.$description: hardware texture; legal inside a bezel only (Law 6)

crosshatch.$value: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.13) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.13) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px)

field.$description: whisper block-shade drafting field for dead background space
